## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-3 (074b): when two canon rules conflict on the same item, the agent records the conflict in rationale.conflicts and selects per the documented precedence ladder
- dd-4 (074b): the agent prompt documents the precedence ladder verbatim and the top-K cap (K<=20) on canon entries loaded per dispatch

## Description
Extend plugins/dso/agents/gov-copy-writer.md prompt with:
- Concrete invocation pattern for top-K canon retrieval: `bash plugins/dso/scripts/ref-query.sh '<query>' --namespace canon --format json` (depends on cce1 task fcc0 landing). K<=20 cap explicitly stated.
- Conflict-resolution algorithm: when two canon rules cite the same item with contradictory guidance, populate rationale.conflicts with both rule_ids and select the canon-rule winner per the documented precedence ladder
- Worked example of conflict + resolution in the prompt

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Prompt documents ref-query.sh invocation with --namespace canon
  Verify: grep -E 'ref-query.*--namespace canon' plugins/dso/agents/gov-copy-writer.md
- [ ] Prompt documents conflict resolution via precedence ladder
  Verify: grep -qE 'rationale\\.conflicts' plugins/dso/agents/gov-copy-writer.md && grep -qE 'precedence' plugins/dso/agents/gov-copy-writer.md

## File Impact
| Path | Action |
| plugins/dso/agents/gov-copy-writer.md | Edit |

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet); escalate to opus then user per standard policy
